pages.text: Companions gain XP by fighting:$(li)Killing a monster themselves gives the most.$(li)Helping with a kill gives some.$(li)When $(thing)you$() kill a monster, companions within 24 blocks also learn.$(br2)The maximum level is $(thing)20$(). Each level-up heals them by half their health.

pages.title: Per Level
pages.text: Every level adds:$(li)+1.5 max health$(li)+0.25 base damage$(li)+0.5 natural armor$(li)a little armor toughness and speed$(br2)From $(thing)level 5$() they unlock their class $(l:epicvanguard:classes/warcries)warcry$().

pages.title: Choosing a Class
pages.text: A plain $(thing)Warrior$() can pick a class at $(thing)level 5$(). Open the $(thing)Talents$() tab, press $(thing)⇄$() to preview the $(l:epicvanguard:classes/berserker)Berserker$(), $(l:epicvanguard:classes/guardian)Guardian$() or $(l:epicvanguard:classes/duelist)Duelist$() tree, then $(thing)Choose class$() and $(thing)Confirm$().$(br2)It is permanent. Level, XP, name and gear are kept.
